_meta.topic: Deep re-mine of DSpark PDF (Eagle3 + DFlash drafter comparison) and MirrorCode PDF (per-size + failure modes + production-SLA speedup)
sources: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSpec/blob/main/DSpark_paper.pdf (33pp, lead Xin Cheng @ PKU + DeepSeek-AI, stamped 2026-06-27)
_meta.notes: Second pass on both PDFs after S155/S156 captured only headline tables. DSpark paper Table 1 grid yields full 4-backbone × 9-task × 3-drafter cube (108 cells + 12 macros), of which we adopt the 8 NEW (Eagle3+DFlash × 4 backbones) macro averages. KEY BURIED FACT: Eagle3 actually BEATS DFlash on Gemma4-12B target (4.376 vs 4.018) — DSpark's gain over Eagle3 is only +6.6% on Gemma vs +26-31% on the Qwen3 family. Production: V4-Flash +51% throughput at 80 tok/s SLA / V4-Pro +52% at 35 tok/s SLA (DIFFERENT from matched-throughput speedup already in DB). Confidence-scheduled verification shrinks chat acceptance ECE from 5.7-8.2% raw to ~1% calibrated. MirrorCode: per-size derived from Fig 2 heatmap — Opus 4.7 is ONLY model to solve any L target (cprepro 100%, large=25%). GPT-5.5 + Gemini both L=0%. Failure-mode cheating rate (Fig 6) is HONESTY signal: Opus 4.7 0% / GPT-5.5 14.2% / Gemini 3.1 Pro 18.9% — cheating defined as 'modifies test files or uses non-functional shortcuts'. Cost: Opus 4.7 mean $106 max $2,846; Gemini mean $162 max $2,698. SKIPPED per Latest-Models-Focus: Opus 4.1, GPT-5 (Figure 10 subset-only, not comparable to overall scores).
